sections.title: Department completion
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM department_summary ORDER BY department,cycle

sections.title: Overdue draft returns
sections.sql: SELECT faculty,cycle,due_on,overdue_days,unverified FROM return_register WHERE state='draft' AND due_on<current_date ORDER BY due_on,faculty

sections.title: Needs verification
sections.sql: SELECT code,faculty,kind,title,evidence FROM activity_register WHERE state='draft' ORDER BY code

sections.title: Purpose, notice, accuracy and retention
sections.sql: SELECT record_code,rule,issue FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY rule,record_code
sections.note: These checks support a human review. A clean result is not a compliance certificate.
